ITEM 1 | Golden-brown waveform-grid patties, three pieces stacked/overlapping on the left and center of the plate, with a uniform criss-cross grid pattern and crisp edges, a dry matte surface with light browning, roughly 10 cm across per piece and about 1.5 cm thick | 150
ITEM 2 | Scrambled-looking yellow-tan crumbled mixture with visible flecks of green, sitting in a mound about 6 cm across and 1.5 cm high, slightly moist with a soft, loose, crumbly texture, partly on top of the waffle pieces | 90
ITEM 3 | Bright green florets, small piece of cooked broccoli-like vegetable about 3 cm across, slightly glossy, sitting at the base of the mound beside the waffles | 15
ITEM 4 | Opaque white soft cheese-like chunks, irregular pieces about 2 to 3 cm, moist sheen, partly melted and fluffy-edged, scattered over the mound and waffles on the upper left | 60
ITEM 5 | Small crumbs of white soft cheese scattered on the plate and tablecloth edge at lower left, each under 1 cm | 5
ITEM 6 | Round browned sausage slices, about 2.5 cm diameter and 1 cm thick, glossy reddish-brown surface with slight caramelized edges, six or seven pieces arranged in an arc along the right side of the plate | 90
